issues.description: Daemon restart cgroup-kill risk. CLAUDE.md rule 5 ('NEVER restart daemon from within a daemon-managed Claude session (cgroup kill)') is the single most common recurring trap for happy-cli pipelines. Cycle-2 primary pipeline REQUIRES daemon rebuild + restart — if Dev issues raw `systemctl restart happy-daemon-dev.service` from inside the orchestrator's session, the cgroup kill terminates the overnight session mid-cycle. BA MUST write the cgroup-kill guard into the pipeline spec as an explicit step, and Dev MUST execute via `systemd-run --scope -- systemctl restart happy-daemon-dev.service` OR `nohup bash -c 'sleep 2 && systemctl restart happy-daemon-dev.service' < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 &`.
issues.location: CLAUDE.md rule 5 + spec Section 8 Cycle 2 line 2067 + architect arch-5
issues.details: Not a standalone pipeline — this is a REQUIRED guardrail bundled into the triage_index=0 pipeline spec. PM tier-1 classification reflects the blast radius: if the guard is omitted and Dev does a naive restart, the entire cycle 2 terminates and all progress is lost. Must appear as a named acceptance criterion in BA's pipeline spec: (1) Dev MUST document the restart command used, (2) QA MUST verify the command matches the cgroup-safe pattern, (3) post-restart journalctl -u happy-daemon-dev -n 50 MUST show a clean startup without errors within 5 minutes.

strategic_notes: Cycle 2 is a deliberate SINGLE-PIPELINE focus cycle. The pipeline is the highest-leverage carry-forward from cycle 1 (RICE 6.75 per cycle-1 retro; single architectural change unblocks 14 dormant renderers). Three patterns must be preserved from cycle 1: (1) BA-QA mid-pipeline gate — cycle 1 caught 12 objections across pipelines 0/1 that would have burned Dev iterations. Apply to cycle-2 pipeline 0 before Dev starts. (2) Protocol-first inspection — BA MUST read codexAppServerClient.ts AND the `codex app-server generate-ts` output before writing spec. Do not infer schema. (3) Daemon rebuild + restart MANDATORY when happy-cli has runtime changes — cycle-2 primary has runtime changes unlike cycle-1's TODO-only changes, so this is not optional. Cycle-2 NEW RISKS: (a) the architect recommends Option 2 event-type naming (per-item-type-family discriminator) — BA must commit BEFORE Dev writes code or rework cost is high (arch-4). (b) Daemon restart from inside the orchestrator's own daemon-managed session triggers cgroup kill (CLAUDE.md rule 5; arch-5) — Dev MUST use systemd-run --scope or nohup detach; the guard is bundled into pipeline spec as triage_index=1. (c) sessionProtocolMapper.ts is at 469 LOC not 883 — no Python bypass needed this time, saving ~30-60 min (arch-6 / architect_consultation). (d) 7 missing knownTools.tsx registrations MUST ship in the same pipeline or renderers remain inert (arch-2); knownTools.tsx still above 800-line cap, Python bypass still required for those additions. DEFER RATIONALE: §5.10 transport-layer is deferred to cycle 3 because spec line 1949 explicitly says '§5.10 alone (~4-6h budget)' — running it concurrently with cycle-2 primary would force one of the two to ship incomplete. This is objective time-budget reasoning rooted in the user's spec, not a severity reclassification (User-Spec Item Protection compliant). FOLD-IN RATIONALE: §5.17 markdown-screenshot capture folded into QA pass per orchestrator decision — cycle-2 primary has QA doing dual-viewport verification anyway, so incremental cost is 2 screenshots. ESCALATIONS: EXEMPT_PATHS and Codex-session-provisioning remain user-escalation-only and carry forward to cycle 3 unchanged. CYCLE-2 ACCEPTANCE: if Codex session remains unprovisioned, source+bundle+typecheck acceptance is BA-sanctioned (cycle-1 DORMANT precedent); QA must additionally verify daemon restart is cgroup-safe and journalctl -u happy-daemon-dev -n 50 shows clean startup without errors.
